preconditions.description: The dimensions n, m, and k must be integers between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: len(layers) == n and all(len(layer) == m and all(len(row) == k for row in layer) for layer in layers)
preconditions.description: The input must contain exactly n layers, each with m lines of k characters.

preconditions.expression: all(all(row[j] in {'0', '1'} for j in range(k)) for i in range(m) for layer in layers)
preconditions.description: Each character in the layers must be either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of critical CPUs as a string.
The number of critical CPUs must be non-negative.
The number of critical CPUs cannot exceed the total number of CPUs.
